description: Translate up to 5,000 characters between English and 49 languages, or between any two of them (via English), with automatic source-language detection. Runs on our own server (open-source Argos models), so your text is not sent to a third-party translation service. Every model passes our quality check, and nonsense output is refused and not charged. Quality is best for major languages and rougher for less common ones. $0.01 per call. Price: $0.01 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

text.description: Text to translate (max 5,000 characters). Very short phrases may need from= because their language is ambiguous.

to.description: Target language code (e.g. es, fr, de, lv)
